purpose: A native list with one-line or two-line rows, optional selection controls, identity, tags, counters, and nested groups.
behaviorProvider: Native ul/li structure with shared Checkbox and independent primary row button.

component: Render native ul lists and li items. Nested lists inherit density unless explicitly overridden and visual depth caps at four.
ListItem uses a primary button only when selectable or onSelect is supplied. selectable exposes aria-pressed, while noninteractive rows retain ordinary content semantics.
host: Own selection, checkbox state and row actions; use stable list keys and keep title/subtitle free of nested interactive controls.
Explicitly disable custom action/tag slots when product policy requires it; row disabled only governs its main button and composed checkbox.

requirements.statement: Render native ul lists and li items. Nested lists inherit density unless explicitly overridden and visual depth caps at four.
ListItem uses a primary button only when selectable or onSelect is supplied. selectable exposes aria-pressed, while noninteractive rows retain ordinary content semantics.
Keep row actions, tags and checkboxes as siblings rather than nesting them inside the main button. Checkboxes use title/description associations unless explicitly named and inherit row disabled.
subtitle takes precedence over description. counter=0 remains visible and composes CountBadge with the supplied max/label. selected and checkbox state remain independent.
Own selection, checkbox state and row actions; use stable list keys and keep title/subtitle free of nested interactive controls.
Explicitly disable custom action/tag slots when product policy requires it; row disabled only governs its main button and composed checkbox.

Use data-display group tokens for owned presentation, preserve genuine nested component ownership, and verify the same geometry across Fundamental and Fundamental Floating in light/dark. Keep the documented semantics and state model when composing or extending this family.

limitations: No virtualization, roving-focus listbox, drag sorting or automatic selection cascade is provided.
Authored source coverage is separate from executed interaction, visual, accessibility and consumer-package evidence.
